fact: Benin Telecom's contract with Huawei (signed 2014-08-05, financed by a China Eximbank RMB 496m loan of 2015-04-07) covers rehabilitating a 1,060 km fibre backbone from Cotonou to Malanville; implementation began in December 2016 and the project is recorded as completed by 2018.

The deal record gives the China Eximbank-financed Phase 1 of Benin's National Broadband Network Project, which rehabilitates the existing 1,060 km fibre backbone from Cotonou to Malanville, as completed, with 2018 as its end year; it does not say when traffic resumed.
